title: Promise and Orchard
author: Marguerite Crane
blurb: Coral Oyelaran, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
